scripts.test:python: cd site-check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q
scripts.lint:docs: node slop-lint/cli.ts --lang en --format markdown README.md */README.md apps/*/README.md */CASE-STUDY.md
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:caja && npm run build:chat-widget && npm run build:push-lab && npm run build:receipt && npm run build:writer
scripts.guard:apps: node csp-build-guard/cli.ts --dir dist/apps/caja --config apps/caja/csp-guard.config.json && node csp-build-guard/cli.ts --dir dist/apps/chat-widget --config apps/chat-widget/csp-guard.config.json && node csp-build-guard/cli.ts --dir dist/apps/push-lab --config apps/push-lab/csp-guard.config.json && node csp-build-guard/cli.ts --dir dist/apps/receipt --config apps/receipt/csp-guard.config.json && node csp-build-guard/cli.ts --dir dist/apps/writer --config apps/writer/csp-guard.config.json
